question: What is the meaning of environmental costs and benefits beyond the system boundary of the structure d in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators?
data_point: environmental costs and benefits beyond the system boundary of the structure d
description:
Environmental costs and benefits beyond the system boundary refer to the indirect environmental impacts associated with the construction, use, and end-of-life stages of a building. These impacts are not confined within the building's boundaries but extend to the broader environment. In the context of sustainability and environmental cost indicators, these costs and benefits are crucial for assessing the overall environmental performance of a building project. They help in identifying areas where environmental improvements can be made, thereby supporting the development of more sustainable building practices. <|ENDINPUT>
